data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'ghashiyah', meaning 'triumph' or 'victory'. This name is often given to celebrate a significant achievement or to remind the child of the importance of striving for success in life. The name Ghashiah carries the meaning “Victory, Triumph” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghashiah usually hope their child will grow to embody victory, triumph and live with faith, good character and purpose.
